name: crewboard
description: A progress band above the prompt and a Workers pane: subagents, local claude -p runs, cloud workers and long CLI tasks, with model, task progress, context, cost and time.

language.title: Pane language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en, ru or he (Hebrew, drawn right to left)

autoOpen.title: Open the Workers pane
autoOpen.description: plan: when a plan is reported or a worker in the status file starts; any: also when any subagent starts

workersFile.title: Status file
workersFile.description: Path of workers.json. Empty: crewboard/workers.json under your .claude folder. A leading ~ is your home folder.

repo.title: Git repository
repo.description: Repository whose origin is checked for cloud branches cloud/<ID>. Empty: the session's working directory.
